title: Open-frontier revision for geometry candidates T001-T034
scope: Read-only research revision. Distinguishes solved parameter values from open task families. Requires a finite unresolved configuration, human-attributed construction baseline, natural scalar, and public source. No code implementation.

audit_status_key.family_open: The task family has unresolved parameters, but any chosen configuration still needs a case-level source and baseline.
audit_status_key.selected_open: A concrete parameter/configuration has an explicitly nonmatching construction and bound, or a maintained source labels the current record unresolved.
audit_status_key.closed: The fixed mathematical task is solved; retain only as calibration if useful.
audit_status_key.unverified: Could be open, but the current pass did not verify a selected human baseline and open gap. Do not treat as ready.
